sentences.text: I have visited many big cities, and I have met many interesting people in my life.

sentences.text: I have learned many skills at work, and I have used them every day.
sentences.translation: 我在工作中学会了很多技能,并且每天都在使用它们。

grammar.note: have learned 表示"已经学会了",结果一直延续到现在。

sentences.text: We have traveled to several countries, and we have seen many fascinating places.
sentences.translation: 我们去过好几个国家旅行,看到了许多迷人的地方。

grammar.name: have seen 已经见过
grammar.note: seen 是 see 的过去分词,现在完成时表示见过、经历过。

sentences.text: We have tried local food in every city, and we have taken many photos of the enormous buildings.
sentences.translation: 我们在每个城市都尝过当地美食,还拍了许多宏伟建筑的照片。

grammar.name: 现在完成时 take photos
grammar.note: have taken 是 take 的完成形式,表示"已经拍了"。

grammar.name: 介词短语作定语
grammar.note: of the enormous buildings 修饰 photos,表示"关于/属于……的照片"。

grammar.note: make friends 是固定搭配,完成时 have made 表示"已经交到了"。
